description: Symbol-level policy consumed by scripts/self_host_architecture_report.py. Extends the HSE-58 module manifest (architecture/cidx-module-manifest.json) with checks that require the resolved semantic call graph of CIDX indexing itself, rather than a textual include/CMake scan. The module manifest and its exceptions ledger remain the single source of truth for module-to-module dependency direction; this file only adds a finer, symbol-granularity policy for two named legacy-façade classes and the generated-catalog duplication guard.

moduleCallGraphCheck.description: Every resolved 'calls'/'dispatch_calls' edge whose caller and callee live in different manifest modules must be covered by an allowed module dependency or a matching architecture/cidx-module-manifest.json 'exceptions' entry (source file + fromModule + toModule). This is a second, independent signal from the bootstrap include/CMake scan: it is derived from the resolved call graph of a real self-index rather than source text, so it also catches coupling introduced without a corresponding #include (e.g. through a forward declaration or a base-class pointer).

legacyFacades.description: cidx::Storage is documented in src/storage/storage.hpp as 'Compatibility facade for legacy application code'; its own declared surface is inherited from cidx::SqliteStorageService, so calls into the facade resolve to that class. New production call sites into either name from outside the modules that are architecturally allowed to construct/own storage are rejected; the migration cutover issue is HSE-62. Each baseline entry pins one exact call site (callerFile + calleeQualName + line + col), not every call from that file to that callee -- a new call site at an already-baselined (file, callee) pair is still rejected. Baseline captured by manual/textual audit of direct cidx::Storage constructions in non-exempt modules (2026-07-26), since a completed real self-index run of this repository was not available (see docs/self-host-architecture.md); it covers direct constructions only. `query.plan` is exempt (2026-07-27): src/query/exec.hpp's cidx::query::SqliteQueryReadAdapter is query.plan's own, singular, sanctioned bridge into cidx::SqliteStorageService (it holds a SqliteStorageService& and forwards every QueryReadPort/GraphReadPort read method to it) -- the same shape of dependency-inversion boundary persistence.sqlite/product.application are already exempt for, and the one graph-query-bypass already exempts query.plan for on the equivalent cidx::graph::GraphQuery facade. `find_legacy_facade_violations` now reads `calls`/`dispatch_calls` edges with the resolved (signature-bearing) callee name normalized to its bare form before comparison (see scripts/self_host_architecture_report.py's `_bare_qual_name`) -- member-function calls through an already-held Storage reference are enumerable once a real self-index resolves them; this exemption is a reviewed, deliberate architectural allowance for query.plan's own read adapter, not a statement that such calls are unenumerable.

legacyFacades.description: cidx::graph::GraphQuery (src/graph/query.hpp) is the pre-QueryPlan graph read adapter. The module manifest still allows product.cli and product.application to depend on analysis.graph at module granularity while the QueryPlan migration (HSE-24) is in progress, so this check freezes the exact call sites known at policy-authoring time (see docs/self-host-architecture.md for how the baseline was captured) and rejects any new one. Paying down an existing entry only requires deleting it from the baseline; it never needs re-adding once removed. Each baseline entry pins one exact call site (callerFile + calleeQualName + line + col), not every call from that file to that callee -- a new call site at an already-baselined (file, callee) pair is still rejected. Baseline captured by manual/textual audit of direct cidx::graph::GraphQuery constructions in non-exempt modules (2026-07-26), since a completed real self-index run of this repository was not available (see docs/self-host-architecture.md); it covers direct constructions only -- member-function calls through an already-held GraphQuery reference are not enumerable without a real resolved call graph and are a known, stated gap until one completes.

baseline.rationale: The graph command handler still constructs cidx::graph::GraphQuery directly, the pre-QueryPlan read adapter, instead of routing through python/indexer/queryplan.py's HSE-66 CXQ QueryPlan surface (or its C++ equivalent, src/query/**).
The local explorer UI graph view still constructs cidx::graph::GraphQuery directly, the pre-QueryPlan read adapter, instead of routing through the canonical query.plan surface.

catalogGuard.description: HSE-59 makes catalogs/core.json the single source for symbol-kind and relation identifiers; scripts/generate_catalogs.py is the only writer of the files below. A hand-authored redeclaration of a catalog (id, name) pair anywhere else in a project-owned production source is rejected, independent of whether generate_catalogs.py --check would also (eventually) notice the generated files disagree.
